recommendation: Implement an in-place admission extension around the EXISTING resident backend launch function, plus one real shared allocation owner. Keep manager/domain/relay/readiness/journal objects in place. Do not start with manager replacement or transport handover. This is a practical source integration seam, not evidence of an already installed activation endpoint.

existingInterfaceAudit.finding: hosting.paused=true is destructive to hosting: plans every occupied unit and enforceOff stops/gives up leftovers. Not admission-only pause.
Ordinary manager HTTP routes are health/list/get/spawn/delete; no pause/reservation/hot-load/state-export route in this inspected implementation.
applyNativeRole is an existing source pattern that wraps methods on the same Manager. Called during main startup; no live invocation facility shown.

Backend.start dispatches through this.launch; constructor closure captures original launcher. Replacing backend.launcher alone does NOT replace launch. The functional seam is this.launch / explicit backend start hook, preserving original stop/survey/teardown and existing handles.
Relay serves while manager stdin pipe stays open; manager death closes pipe and relay exits. No reattach/pipe ownership transfer interface found.
recover keeps identity but clears relay/readiness and refuses serving. It is not non-disruptive ownership handover.
Protected recovery also is not serving adoption. protected raw spawn reaches super.spawn and backend, so backend integration must cover this path too.

operations: Owner performs real serialized acquire/validate/observe/release for exact process-incarnation/request identity with full physical/commit upper bounds, live floor and durable unresolved intents. Both role clients share this one owner. Include qualification reservations as real budget consumers. No success-shaped fake capacity adapter.

In-place install first fences ONLY NEW launches at actual backend.launch indirection. Preserve Manager identity, epoch, domains Map and every existing record/handle, judging promise, relay stdin/stdout, data-plane sessions, stop/survey methods and journal owners. Pending already-entered starts stay accounted, never killed for installation.

Bind existing starting/uncertain records and router pending head to baseline reservation coverage. A bound on already-entered allocation effects is required before arming; merely observing launching=false is not proof of OS reflection or unknown cleanup. No global VM drain.

For each new launch acquire cross-manager reservation before underlying allocation. Revalidate local limits after any new await, preserve synchronous local reservation insertion, and forward token only to exact mapping/manager/instance. Invoke actual original launch on positive admission, not a permanent refusal.

At WMI defineType1/New-CustomVM and Start-VM transitions validate same live reservation; retain it across long PowerShell calls and uncertain outcomes. Router/public direct APIs/protected stage all reach this hook. Do not rely on router17GiB check for current>=18GiB floor.

On successful exact observed allocation mark reflected conservatively; on error/timeout/owner death retain unresolved budget until independently confirmed absence or reflection. Losing allocation owner closes only new admission; existing serving domains and explicit Stop remain available.

Two manager clients must acknowledge the same active owner incarnation/sequence and baseline coverage before granting a qualification hold. Waiting router pre-admission closures are not P. Creator footprint E, observer O and uncovered P remain unknown until actual accounting proves them.
actualSourceTestsToWriteNotRun: Use the real Manager/HTTP handlers for both direct /vms APIs and real backend integration with inert external VM boundary: positive admission forwards one actual backend launch and returns normal response. Concurrent cross-role requests cannot oversubscribe.

Install on already-serving real Manager instances; assert SAME record/handle/manager epoch/readiness/relay stdin/data sessions remain, no stop/teardown/recover/reclaim invoked, and subsequent allowed launches use owner. Include existing in-flight starts.
Exercise original constructor launcher capture to ensure replacing wrong property cannot bypass guard; cover ProtectedManager.spawnProtectedInternal and native wrapper.
Hold grant shrinks real available capacity; failed/timeout launch keeps unresolved reservation; confirmed stop/reflection settles exact identity only. Restart owner recovery retains unknown intents.
Stale incarnation/sequence, lost owner, malformed bounds, unexpected direct boundary access and concurrent token revocation fail new allocation without killing serving VMs. Preserve current140 tests.
smallestFunctionalSlice.boundedScope: No new native envelope creator in this slice, no arbitrary extension loader/eval, no exported secret/relay key snapshot, no manager process replacement, no on-chain transition or writer migration.

activationAndHandover.currentlyProvedActivation: NONE. main startup calls composition and bootstrap imports modules once. No supported resident admin extension call was found. Do not imply source wrapper is already invocable in old processes.
activationAndHandover.preferredPath: A proven owner-authenticated resident extension hook could invoke this installer on each current Manager without replacing them. Must establish that hook actually exists/executes reviewed code in those exact resident processes; no debugger/code injection is proposed. If absent, this source slice is installable for future instances, not safely hot-activatable on existing ones.
activationAndHandover.alternativeHandover: Keep old managers/relays as serving owners; do not transfer readiness by JSON or restart/recover. A true future control-owner handover would require cooperative old-manager admission fencing and trusted epoch-bound serving delegation plus preserved relay pipes/sessions. Neither export/fence/delegation nor pipe handover exists in reviewed APIs. A proxy alone leaves direct old POST /vms as bypass, so is not a completed common boundary.
activationAndHandover.explicitGap: There is no source-proven, currently usable non-disruptive activation or serving handover path in the inspected old build. Installed-process evidence might reveal a separate existing capability; until then no honest immediate installation claim is possible.
